explainer_content.short_definition: Indie-rock nerves plugged into club rhythm, electro style, and early-2000s nightlife.
explainer_content.history_capsule: This road catches the moment when bands, DJs, and labels blurred rock shows and dance floors through DFA-style grooves, electroclash pose, and blog-era club culture.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It helped indie listeners accept rhythm, repetition, and DJ culture as part of rock-adjacent taste.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The sound is bodily but self-aware: punk edges, disco bass, synth bite, and scene irony.
